# MID PENN BANK NAMES GREGORY CARLISLE MARKET PRESIDENT FOR CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN NEW JERSEY


Posted on Nov 9th, 2026


Millersburg, Pa. – November 9, 2026. Mid Penn Bank (the “Bank”), a wholly owned subsidiary of Mid Penn Bancorp, Inc. (“Mid Penn”) (NASDAQ: MPB), is pleased to announce that Gregory Carlisle has joined the Bank as executive vice president and market president for central and southern New Jersey. Based at the Bank’s Mt. Laurel Administrative Center, Carlisle will lead all customer relationship development and administrative efforts throughout the New Jersey market. Carlisle will initially report to Bank President and CEO Rory Ritrievi and later to Eastern Division President Robert Curley.


Carlisle brings more than 20 years of experience leading commercial, small business and retail banking teams across New Jersey and the greater Philadelphia region. Most recently, he served as senior vice president and commercial market president of southern and coastal New Jersey at TD Bank, where he led commercial and small business operations and oversaw retail banking across the market. During more than a decade with TD Bank, Carlisle held several senior leadership roles focused on business development, client relationships and team management. Earlier in his career, he held senior positions with HSBC Bank, JPMorgan Chase and Wachovia Bank across commercial lending, credit and relationship management.


“Greg brings deep New Jersey banking experience and long-standing relationships across the market,” Ritrievi said. “His background in commercial, small business and retail banking is a strong fit for our New Jersey market, and we are excited to have him on board.”


Carlisle has completed professional training in credit and risk through Moody’s and Fitch. In 2026, he was named to SJ Biz magazine’s Power 50 and received the Admiral Halsey Award for Business Leadership from Battleship New Jersey. He currently serves on the boards of the Chamber of Commerce Southern New Jersey, the Southern New Jersey Development Council and Camden Community Partnership, on the advisory board for Rowan University’s College of Education and is the 2026 chair of Blood Cancer United’s Light the Night Walk in New Jersey. Carlisle completed the Secondary Education Teaching Program at Temple University.


**About Mid Penn Bank**


Mid Penn Bank, headquartered in Millersburg, Pennsylvania, has been serving the community since 1868. The Bank operates 59 retail locations throughout Pennsylvania and central and southern New Jersey, and has total assets of over $7 billion. Mid Penn offers a comprehensive portfolio of financial products and services to meet the banking needs of the communities it serves. To learn more, please visit[www.midpennbank.com](https://www.midpennbank.com/) .
